# Changelog

Changes to the eeid-toolkit plugin, newest first. Each entry is one plugin
version and lists every skill that changed, with its skill version.


## 0.5.0 - 2026-11-20

Add the independent BYOUX skill with default-first discovery, four required inputs, early application enablement planning, tenant-verified domain and subdomain validation, customer CSS, tooling preflight, full selected-journey UI and Native API integration, public V2 examples with bounded browser transport, manual user-flow creation/reuse with separately approved optional flow automation, shared sign-in/recovery layout, validated POST-only login controls, reachable isolated previews, and explicit provisioning execution evidence.

| Skill | Skill version |
| --- | --- |
| `eeid-implement-byoux` | 0.1.0 |
